metadata.title: ABM - Run ATLAS Behavior Map response plan
metadata.description: Runs the response plan that an ATLAS Behavior Map analytic rule attaches to its alert (custom detail ResponsePlan). Steps with status auto run right away; steps with status awaiting_approval are sent for Outlook approval first. Each ABM action name (ACTION_REGISTRY) has its own Switch case that POSTs to your action endpoint; replace a case with a native connector where you have one. Results are added to the incident as a comment.
prerequisites: An HTTPS action endpoint (Azure Function or API Management) that carries out ABM actions and accepts Microsoft Entra tokens for the audience you pass as ActionEndpointAudience.
A mailbox or distribution list that approves gated actions (ApproverEmail).
postDeployment: Authorize the Office 365 Outlook connection (API connections > office365-<PlaybookName>).
Assign the playbook's managed identity the Microsoft Sentinel Responder role on the workspace.
Allow the managed identity on the action endpoint.
Create an automation rule that runs this playbook when an ABM alert is created.

metadata.description: HTTPS endpoint that carries out ABM actions. Receives {action, params, plan_row, behavior_id, alert}.
Microsoft Entra audience (application ID URI) the action endpoint accepts.
ISO 8601 duration to wait for approval. No answer means the step is not run.
Region for the Logic App and its API connections.
